name: Komatsubara Yomi
source:
Yomi is a first-year student and is in the same class as [url=/c17128]Ria[/url]. She is a rather discreet young girl, and she is rarely seen talking with anyone. The few people who have the courage to go and talk to her then have the right to a consolation prize: to be sent back by the young girl.

Currently, only [url=/c17131]Masato[/url] hasn't been intimidated by the girl, but is it only due to his sweet nature?
